environment.audio: Media volume verified zero before each run

method.recording: Native screenshots at at most 3 fps, 1000px long edge, JPEG quality 0.65. Separate HTTP connection/capture lane. No audio. Capture timestamps recorded; encoding happens after all measurements.
method.timing: After reset and initial video frame: fresh observation, actions, independent fresh AX verification. Recording continues during both modes. Reset, launch, first camera frame and encoding excluded; setup duration recorded separately.
method.limits: Ten different tasks, one pair each. No statistical per-task latency claim. Scripted batch is an execution floor with known steps, not a competing general planner. JEV must choose among current permitted keys/tabs. General cross-app reliability and end-to-end agent speed are not established.

tasks.name: add
tasks.goal: Calculate 7 + 8 in Calculator and press Equals. Finish with the displayed result 15.
